summary: dependencykfeg ships preinstall DNS beacon leaking installer CWD
details: dependencykfeg@1.5.6 contains no library code — the tarball ships only package.json whose `main` points at a non-existent index.js — and its sole runtime effect is a `preinstall` lifecycle script that hex-encodes `process.cwd()` and emits it as a subdomain under `.google.com` via `dns.lookup`. This fires automatically on `npm install` and transmits the installer's build path to whoever controls resolution of that DNS zone, matching the canonical dependency-confusion / exfiltration beacon pattern. No legitimate functionality is present to justify the behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
